༄༅/ /'khrul zhig sangs rgyas dbon po'i rnam thar nyid kyis mdzad pa nor bu'i gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khrul zhig sangs rgyas dbon po'i rnam thar nyid

kyis mdzad pa nor bu'i gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / dgongs klong mkha' ltar dag pa chos sku'i mkha' klong la/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa longs sku'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /sprul pa'i 'od kyis 'gro ba'i mun pa sel/ /sku gsum mngon gyur drin can bla ma rgyal gyur cig /tshad med pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rjes 'gro ba rnams yang dag pa'i lam la 'khrid par mdzad pa'i ded dpon dam pa de las/ kho bos yang zab bla na med pa'i gdams pa ma lus pa thob cing*/ /nyams su len cing skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya gcig gnyis tsam la gdams pa'i don gnang bar byed kyin yod pa'i thad du/ dad mos dang ldan pa'i bu slob 'ga' zhig gis/ kho bo'i rnam thar cung zhig bris gsung pa la brten nas/ kho bo'i rnam thar la sogs bkod pa'i 'os can ma yin zhing*/ log lta can rnams kyis sgrib pa bsags pa'i rkyen du gyur kyang*/ khong rnam pa'i nan ma thub pa la brten nas/ kho bo'i rnam thar nor bu'i gsal byed bkod pa la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bzod par gsol la thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhing*/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bzhengs pa'i bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po ma ga dta rdo rje gdan dang gnyis su med pa'i yul byang dkar gyi lha sdings zhes bya ba ni/ kho bo'i yul yin/ kho bo'i skye ba snga ma'i skye sa gtsug lag khang chen po 'di'i byang phyogs na/ sangs rgyas ma chags padma can gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed gling zhes bya ba'i bya 'dabs gling 'og ces bya bar/ pha ni spa kun dga' rgyal mtshan ces bya ba dang*/ ma ni ngam mo dad pa skyid ces bya ba'i bur skyes shing der yang las kyi dbang gis chos la mi tshud pa'i rigs su 'dug pa/

dkon mchog gi thugs rje la brten nas lo bdun brgyad kyi dus su tshe'i dus byas te/ yang de kha'i gong la gdangs 'brel/ pha dge gnyen padma skyabs bya ba dang*/ ma 'brom mo skyid pa legs zhes bya ba'i bur skyes nas/ bu kho bo gcig pu las med pa'i stabs kyis chos sgor mi 'jug cing*/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba la 'jug bsam pa yod na yang nga rang tshe sngon gyi las bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang*/ drin can bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje la brten nas/ lo lnga'i steng du khyi smyon gyis nyi ma gung mthil la rmugs pas/ kho bo bstan pa'i sgor 'jug pa'i 'dren pa'i bla ma 'di byung zhing*/ gzhan yang kho bo chung ngu nas/ dad mos ldan pa zhig yod pa la brten te/ dbyar gyi dus su gtsug lag khang chen por phyogs nas gdan drangs pa'i mkhan po dung stong bzhi la sogs pa rnams kyis gtor ma gtong pa'i gtor skad btang ba de thos pa la brten nas/ kho bos yang dran pa sad pa snyam byed de/ phor chung rer chu thigs pa re dang*/ rtsam pa phum re blugs nas dgongs mo sa rub mtshams su nam mkha' la gtor/ gtor ma la 'byon par zhu zer pa'i skad ring gsum gsum nam mkha' la gtong dus/ nam mkha' la bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bzhugs pa snyam byed cing*/ res 'ga' gdug 'dre e yin bsam/ 'jigs zhum pa zhud tshil pa yang byung*/ de'i dus dad pa mos gus dang*/ snying rje chen po yang bongs la bstun pa'i chen po yod pa la brten nas/ lo bdun gyi steng du mkhan chen shes rin dang*/ slob dpon lha shes rab rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du dge tshul gyi bslab pa blangs shing*/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas dad pa dang shes rab 'thad rab yod pa la/ kho bo'i slob chung gcig gi spun la dbang phyug zer ba zhig la mdze byung nas/ de'i g.yog byug pa la sogs thams cad byas pas/ kho bo'i dad pa dang shes rab thams cad des 'grib nas/ shes rab snying po 'dzin pa la/

zla ba gsum gyi bar du slob dpon gyis rgyugs blangs/ kho bos rgyugs ma 'phrod par/ slob dpon gyis brdungs pa'i skyel ma yang mdze pho des byas pas/ shes rab je chung la song zhing*/ de dus phar phy-in la slob gnyer zhig byas pas kyang*/ shes rab med pa'i stobs kyis/ rang sbyong la mi ma mgu ba zhig byung lags shing*/ de dus bla ma shā kya rin chen pa'i drung du/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po dpa' bo gcig pa dang*/ dbyangs can ma/ mi g.yo ba dkar po/ 'jam dpal smra seng dang bcas pa rnams kyi lung zhus nas/ zang 'jam dbyangs dkar po la mos pa byung ste/ de la bsnyen pa byas pas/ des byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags la/ sngar med pa'i byams pa dang*/ snying rje rgyud la dungs pa skye ba dang*/ nub gcig gi rmi lam na yang*/ mi dkar po zhig gis shel gyi phreng ba dang*/ po ti byin pa dang*/ ldum ra zhig gi nang na me tog tsam pa ka dkar la dngas pa'i khrod nas/ me tog phor ba tsam 'thu ba la sogs pa rmis pa dang*/ kho bos yig cha 'dzin pa la tshig rkang gnyis gnyis tsam las mi zin pa de la/ yug kha gras kyi yig phreng bdun phreng gi shog log re tsam zin pa byung bas/ de la brten nas slob gnyer la ci nus su byed kyin yod pa'i thad nas/ yi dam de'i thugs rje la brten nas/ snying rje dang dag snang chen po rgyud las skyes pa'i mthus/ bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag mkhan chen rin po che bsod nams grags pa dang*/ mkhan chen rin po che bsod nams bzang po dpon slob gnyis kyi drung du/ phar phyin dang*/ spyod 'jug dang*/ 'dul ba la sogs pa rnams kyang nyan cing*/ gzhan yang rta mgrin dang sgrol ma la sogs pa/ bka' gdams lha bzhi la sogs pa'i lung dang*/ mdor na bya spyod kyi lha mang rabs kyi lung thob cing*/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid mkhan chen rin po che bu ston kha che'i drung du/ slob dpon gzhon bzang gis zhus pa'i zhar la/

sa skya pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ yum chen mo'i sgrub thabs dang*/ thugs rje chen po dpal mo lugs/ 'jam dpal smra seng*/ yum du sgrub pa dang bcas pa rnams thob cing bla ma shā kya rin chen pa'i drung du/ snga phyi bar gsum dril te thob pa la/ kye rdo rje'i dbang bskur/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang bskur/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang bskur/ nā ro mkha' sbyod kyi byin rlabs/ rtsa dbu ma'i khrid dang bcas/ bcom ldan 'das ye shes khyung khra'i sgrub thabs/ rta mgrin drag po sum sbrags kyi sgrub thabs/ phyag rdor ras chung lugs kyi dbang sgrub thabs dang bcas pa/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba dang bcas pa'i khrid/ kun mkhyen rin po che jo nang pa'i lugs gyi khrid lung dang*/ gcod yul sras brgyud kyi skor la / stong pa dbang rgyal gyi khrid lung o rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi khrid gegs sel gdams pa dang bcas pa ma lus pa thob/ gzhan yang bskyed rim rdzogs rim la sogs pa mang du thob/ bla ma ye rgyal ba'i drung du/ gcod yul chos kha tshang ba dang gzhan yang nges don gyi khrid dang*/ yi dam lha'i lung mang du thob/ mkhan chen rin po che gzhon nu mgon po'i drung du/ khro phu ba'i lugs kyi man ngag brgya rtsa/ chos chung brgya rtsa/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la sogs pa dang*/ sman lha'i mdo chog jo bo'i lugs kyi gtor lung rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i man ngag du ma thob cing*/ mkhan chen rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/ phar phyin dang*/ 'dul ba/ spyod 'jug par ṇa sha wa ri/ lha mo 'od zer can dang*/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ dpal don yod zhags pa/ a mo gha pa sha'i rgyud dang bcas pa/ rnam thos sras kyi rjes gnang*/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid/ blo sbyong la sogs pa mang du thob cing*/ gzhan yang de'i dus bdag la shes rab cung zad skyes pa'i mthus/

nan tan la gtso cher byas nas/ chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon po bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i drung nas/ chos 'khor chen po'i gsos rnams zhabs tog la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa legs par bsgrubs nas/ bya lo zla ba dang po'i tshes gsum nas sta gon btsugs shing*/ tshes bco lda'i nyin par rab tu gnas pa'i dngos gzhi mdzad/ tshes bcu bdun la mjug gi chog legs par rdzogs par mdzad pa'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin par chos kyi rje rin po che bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas gtso ra mdzad cing*/ bstan pa'i gsal byed bla ma gung pa la sogs pa/ dpal ldan sa skya pa/ gtsang phyogs kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa bzang rags thams cad 'tshogs ba dang*/ mkhan rin po che brul phu ba dang*/ dgal ldan pa blo gros seng ges dbu mdzad dbu ru stod smad kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen par bzang rags 'tshogs pa dang spyan mda' grags pa rgyal mtshan pas gtso mdzad dbu ru lung pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang rag tshogs pa mdor na tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su/ pha rol tu phyin pa la thos pa'i bya ba'i che ba dbyung zhing*/ nyan bshad byed pa'i dga' ston la dmigs te/ bdag cag la bzung 'chad la sogs pa cher mod kyang*/ drin can bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang*/ mched grogs gong ma nye 'brel rnams kyis thugs la btags pa la brten nas/ mang ja 'bul nod dang bcas pa legs par bsgrugs nas/ nyan bshad byed pa la dmigs nas/ chos grwa chen po rtse thang du phyin te/ drung 'jam dbyangs shā kya rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/ phar tshad 'dul ba mngon pa la sogs pa nyan cing*/ slob dpon dpal rgyal ba dang*/ slob dpon paṇḍi ta'i drung du/ phar phyin nyan pas/ phar phyin gyi don thams cad lhongs par go ba yang byung chos rje rin po che mon phyogs nas/ yar 'brog tu phyags phebs/ lho phyogs nas phebs pa'i sku skyos la skyi g.yong la sogs pa'i dgon sde rnams su/

mang ja 'bul nod la sogs pa mdzad nas/ de rnams 'grub pa'i gtam snyan skyel ba la 'gro dus dge bshes kun dga' dpal mo rnams kyis/ nged la'ang*/ chos rje mjal ba la 'gro ba 'thad gsung nas/ nged kyis kyang mjal ba la phyin/ nged rang gi bshad gsar byas ba'i sku skal dang*/ phyags phebs pa'i shangs len la/ sku 'khor sum brgya tsam 'dug pa la/ mang ja/ chos rje'i drung du 'bul ba/ gzhan yang gang 'os kyi 'bul ba dang*/ dge 'dun so so'i phyag tu dar kha re'i 'gyed dang bcas pa bsgrubs nas bsdad yod dus/ bla ma bzod pas dbu mdzad/ gros la dbang ba rnams kyis nged la zhal ta byon pa la/ da lta sha ba rwa co'i 'bogs mtshams su 'dug pas/ khyod kyis chos rje'i nye gnas gyis/ sha yang khyod rang tsha ba yin gsung pa la/ nged kyis zhu ba byas nas/ mi ltog gi gces phrug gang yang mi shes/ mthong goms la sogs ci yang med pa'i skyid de par bsdad pas/ 'di 'dra'i zhabs tog mi yong lags shing*/ nga'i mgo 'don byas pa mi yong bar/ mgo smod pa 'dra ba zhig las mi yong pas khyed rnams kyis zhu nas/ nga rang rgyags kha se mda' re tsam khyer nas/ phyag phyir 'brang nas gdams ngag gi zhun thar chod pa zhig byung na thugs la btags de ma byung na/ dad pa can gyi dkor zas kyis tshos nas sems la 'dre zhugs nas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis bya ba gang min byas nas/ ma jo btsun ma la sogs pa la byi phrug bton pa la sogs pa byung na/ chos rje rin po che'i zhabs 'dren/ nged rang gi mgo smad du song nas 'di phyi gnyis ka'i 'dun ma 'chor ba las mi yong bas/ de 'dra mi gsung bar zhu byas/ nga rang gis thag bcad ma nyan pa dang*/ chos rje rin po che'i drung nas kyang thugs rjes bzung nas de mi 'thad/ na so gzhon pas da dung slob gnyer gyis gsung nas zhal ta bzang po dang*/ dpal ldan a ti sha'i thugs dam spyan ras gzigs kyi sku li ma gcig gdung khang pad spungs dang bcas pa gcig phar phyin gyi gzhung*/

brgyad stong 'grel chen dbu zhwa na bza' bzhugs gdan dang bcas pa gnang nas/ na so gzhon pa la slob gnyer gyis mtshan nyid pa 'di dad pa chung bas blo chud zos la ma song bar mig mar lta ma byed par yar lta gyis la blo chos dang mthun par gyis/ de ltar byas na rang la khebs che zhing gzhan la phan par yong gsung*/ de dus chos rje'i drung du/ rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba thig le'i skor/ khrid rgyab chos su snyan brgyud yi ge can dang yi ge med pa la sogs pa'i rgyud man ngag dang bcasas pa ma lus pa zla ba gsum gyi bar du gnang*/ gzhan yang yang dben pa'i dbon po yin zer ba zhig gi zhar la shog gsungs nas/ tshogs bdag dmar po/ tshogs bdag sprel gdong ma dang bcas pa rnams ma lus par thugs la btags/ slob gnyer byed pa la 'di tsho la gsol ba thob gsungs nas mi g.yo ba dkar po/ sngon po pus btsugs/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na/ smra seng*/ phag mo/ shes rab gsal byed rnams kyi lung dang rjes gnang*/ byin rlabs dang bcas pa ma lus par gnang*/ gzhan yang thugs rje chen po rgyal po lugs dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i skor ma lus pa dang*/ o rgyan rin po che sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang*/ kun byed rgyal po la sogs sems sde'i skor mang dag tu gnang zhing*/ gzhan yang gu ru'i thugs sgrub dbang dang bcas pa/ rdzogs chen mnyam nyid rang grol la sogs ma lus pa thugs la btags/ pha rgan dang bsdongs nas bsam yas su slebs/ de'i dpyid so ra rgyal nang du grub thob nam mkha'i snying po'i sgrub khang gi zhol du*/ zla ba gsum gyi bar du 'phags ma dbyangs can ma la gsol ba btab pas/ rmi lam du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma 'dra byung zhing*/ de'i bsnyen pa'i kha ska ོ nga la sbyin sreg cig nyi shu dgu'i nyin par byas pas/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la sbyin sreg byed pa'i steng du/ 'ja' tshon bla res phub pa 'dra ba byung bas de dus bla ma shākya rin chen pa bzhugs pas/

rten 'brel legs po yin gsung nas/ de nas bzung nas shin tu thugs la 'dogs pa zhig byung*/ lar na de dus rmi lam gyi rtags mtshon pa de dang*/ sems can thams cad la pha ma'i 'du shes/ byams snying rje rang shugs kyis skye ba zhig byung*/ de'i dbyar so/ rgyal sras rin po che thogs med pa mjal nas/ theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi khrid dang*/ snying po don gsum gyi khrid/ de la sogs pa'i bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi lung ma lus ba thugs la btags/ de'i dus su byams pa dang*/ snying rje nges 'byung gi skyo shas drag po zhig skyes nas/ khong gi drung du chang mi 'thung ba dang*/ rdor nag bsrung pa dang*/ lus skyes sems can phyir mi 'dor ba dang*/ mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge sbyor phran tshegs la sogs pa'i dam bca' du ma dag tu phul bas/ blo mi rtag rgyud la skyes pa dang*/ blo sna btsan thabs su thung ba byung bas/ slob gnyer gyis kyang 'chi khar mi phan par 'dug bsams nas slob gnyer la yang blo gzhol du song zhing*/ gzungs kyi dpal ba'i drung du/ rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms/ chos skyong gur mgon/ bde mchog dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur/ mdor na phran tshegs kyi yi dam lha'i sgrub thabs ma lus pa thob/ chos rje rin po che rang byung rol pa'i rdo rje'i drung du/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lung dang*/ sku gsum ngo sprod la sogs pa mdor na mang du thob/ mkhan chen bsod rnams rin chen pa'i drung du/ mdo bka' 'gyur gyi lung dang sa skya pa'i rgyal sras lam bzang la sogs pa mdor na ma lus pa thob/ bla ma kun gzhon pa'i drung du sku gsum ngo sprod/ nā ro chos drug 'phags pa skal pa bzang po/ mdo drin len bsabs pa la sogs pa mang dag tu thob cing*/ bla ma bzod pa'i drung du chos rje rin po ches mdzad pa'i dngul chu'i bcud len gyis thog drangs/ gsung sgros kha 'thor thams cad thob/

chos rje paṇa chen pa'i drung du/ phyag rgya chen po'i yi ge bzhi pa/ ro snyoms sgang dril/ zhang tshal pa'i gzer lnga/ thog babs/ tshe dpag med ras chung lugs kyi sgrub thabs/ dbang chog dang bcas pa tshang bar thob/ phag mo shes rab gsal shes kyi byin rlabs sgrub thabs dang bcas pa/ gsar ma lugs kyi bcom ldan 'das kyi skyes rabs/ bla ma mar ston grags rgyal gyi drung du/ phyag rgya chen po lhan gcig skyes sbyor bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po thob/ rdzogs chen a ro'i khrid mo che/ phyag rgya chen po gang ga ma la sogs mang dag tu thob/ bla ma rtogs ldan shes rab mgon po'i drung du/ phyag rgya chen po bsam gtan thun chog snga bzhi'i ngo sprod/ mkha' 'gro gsang khrid/ ri chos ma'i lus sbyong*/ gtum mo lus sbyong nyi shu pa/ rgyun gcod rtag ngu/ 'bru can rde'u la sogs pa'i dka' thub/ bcud len gyi be bum chen mo thob/ de nas chos rje rin po che nyid 'bri gung na bzhugs pa/ gdan 'dren phyin nas bsam yas su phyag phebs dus khrid mgyogs par tshugs nas yong gsungs nas/ stag lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la khrid btsugs nas/ tshes bco brgyad/ phyi tshes bcu bdun gyi nyi ma phyed tsam la gshegs dus/ nam mkha' 'ja' dang 'od kyis khengs*/ gzims khang la 'ja'i gur phub snang srid thams cad 'ja' 'od zer gsum gyis khengs/ sa g.yos chen po lan mang dag tu byung*/ pur sbyong dus/ sa gzhi thams cad ring bsrel spyan ljags/ thugs sku gzugs yi ge lnga la sogs pa gcal bkram nas mi rnams ngo mtshar gyi sa la bkod pa'i dus/ drung du bzhugs pa rnams kyis zhal ta thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ zhal ta mang pos ci byed/ dngos po gang 'dug gi

min mo skyid pa lags zhes pa 'di la sprul sku grags pa 'od zer ba 'khrungs rgyu yin pas mang 'gyed byed pa yin mod gsungs nas zhal ta gzhan ma gnang zhing*/ lar khyer tsho'i lhag byung na skyid pa lags la nyer len zhig ltos gsung pa dang*/ dge bshes de ga na 'dug /'dug na 'dir shog gyis gsung pa'i zhal ta theng gnyis gsum du gnang ba yin na'ang drung na bzhugs pa'i mkhan sangs rdor dang*/ dge bshes kun dga' dpal la sogs pa rnams kyis/ bla ma shā kya rin chen pa'i phyogs 'deng byas nas nged la ni zhal ta ma bsgyur/ de steng stod smad kyi yon bdag gra ba bu slob yod pa gros la dbang ba rnams 'dus pa'i dus su/ nged rang la'ang rngan chen che ba la la sogs bsam yas pa rnams kyis byas pas ston pa/ gzhan rnams kyis de bzhin du byas byung bas/ mi go ma chod thing nge ba las med lags shing*/ thams cad kyis lkugs nag zer ba'i dus su nga rang gi rtog pa la dpal kun tu bzang po'i rgyal tshab chos kyi rje rin po che la 'di lta bu byung nas/ nga la gzhan gang gis kyang ci byed/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad btang nas/ mi khyu nas bud pa byas te/ ngo mi shes pa'i sa phyogs su phyin nas/ dpon por bla ma dkon mchog spyi bor khur/ kha drag tu/ kha nyen dbang chung la rgyab gtad/ dma' mo'i sa bzung*/ hrul po'i gos gyon nas/ sprang po ltar gang gis kyang mthong tshod med pa byas te/ tshe gcig gi sgrub pa nan tan snying por ma byas na/ gzhan gang gis kyang phan par mi 'dug pa la/ da nga 'di tsho'i gseng tu ci byed bsam pa byung bas/ khong rnam kyi khrod du ma bzhugs pas/ 'dis logs man yin pa 'dra ba'i thugs dgongs byung nas/ nga la shogs gsungs pa'i zhal ta 'byon gyin 'dug pas/ yang blo zha ི ga skyes te/ gal te khong rnam pa'i thugs dang 'gal ba byas pas kyang mi yong*/ lar ngas der phyin kyang gzhan gyi zhabs tog ni mi yong ste/

pur gyi zhabs tog tsam zhig byung na bsam nas/ khong rnam pa'i khrod du phyin/ ming nga rang la blo gros dang dngos po la sogs pa 'don rgyu yod pa der ni mi 'dug /'dir yong ba la pur kyi zhabs tog tsam zhig byung na/ thugs la 'dogs par zhu zer ba zhus pas bla ma rin po che gu ru ba dang*/ bla ma rin po che rtse dpon slob gnyis dang*/ zul phu gnas kyi a khu ston pa/ ston pa grags rdor la sogs pa mdor na stod smad kyi yus po che rnams zhabs tog byed zer/ khong rnams dang yang ma 'cham pa'i skabs su/ a khu ston pas kha rdol byas nas/ da 'di rigs la mi 'cham pa byas pas kyang mi yong*/ sus zhabs tog byas kyang byin rlabs ma gtogs/ bza' yong ba de yang min pas 'di'i 'thad 'os sus bltas kyang*/ kho rang dbon po'i 'os yin pas/ kho rang byed du chugs gsungs nas kha phol byung bas/ nga rang gi lus sems la 'ang sa dang po thob pa'i bde ba tsam rnyed byung ba dang*/ khong rnam pa tsho ma 'cham pa de bdag gi grogs su byung nas/ pur gyi zhabs tog bya chog pa byung bas/ de'i byin brlabs kyis nged rang la grogs med na'ang*/ da bar skyid po byas pa yin/ de nas chos rje rin po che'i gshegs rdzongs/ phyogs kyis ja bkol rnams bsgrubs pa'i bar der/ bdag gi pha rgan yun ring*/ zug gzer che ba byas nas/ cis kyang phan ma thogs par 'das/ kho bos shul du dge ba dge gzhug la sogs mi la ngo mi tsha tsam bsgrubs / nges 'byung dang skyo shas mi rtag pa snying nas tshe 'di'i zhen pa log pa tsam zhig byung*/ de'i bar der chos rje rin po che'i nang rten/ mchod khang sogs bzhengs pa la/ lus ngag yid gsum la zol med kyi thil blangs nas/ zhabs tog la 'bungs te brtsigs pa las/ sdig pa dag ba'i rtags la sogs pa yang mang dag tu byung*/ lus sems la yang tshe 'di'i snang ba log pa'i nyams than thun yang skyes/ nang rten mchod khang dang bcas pa bar chad med par grub/

de'i dus su yang*/ bdag gi ma rgan mo yang gcong dam po zhig gis zin nas/ zla ba drug tsam gyi bar du nad pa ska rags can nyam thag pa byung zhing*/ de nas zla ba bdun gyi bar du gdan la 'byar nas/ bsgul bskyod la sogs pa gang yang mi shes pa/ kha ru sing po phye btab pa hub re ma gtogs pa gang yang mi 'gro ba/ de yang 'thung mi shes par kho bos smyug sbubs ring po bcas nas/ de khar bcug nas byin pas shes tsam byung*/ de'i dus su nged rang la spun zla dang a lce sring mo med par mi gcig po lag gcig tu song bas/ lus ngag gi thog tu nyin mtshan gnyis kha sbyor spyod de che byung yang*/ sems thog tu khyod 'dra ba yong ba/ lus la na tsha ni med/ rang bzhin gyis g.yog byas pas chog pa 'di la khyod sdug bsngal 'di 'dra yong bas/ snying mi bzod pa 'dug lar skyon che ma rgan mo 'di'i khong pa'i nang du zla ba dgu/ ngo dang bcu'i bar du khur spyod spyod dpag tu med pa byas/ skyes nas kyang snab khas 'phyi ba dang*/ shu shu lag pas 'phyi ba la sogs pa byas/ gsos bskyangs byas pa'i drin can yin pa la/ da 'di 'dra'i skyo ngal mi bzod pa khyod 'dra ba yong ba bsam nas/ des rkyen byas nas sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje chen po skye ba'i rkyen byas pas ma rgan mo de drin che bar byung*/ de nas ma rgan mo 'das nas rjes kyi bya ba rnams bsgrubs/ lcags zad brdar zad la song ba'i stabs kyis pur de sbyin sreg cig byed rgyu yang ma byung*/ pur de dur khrod du gdan drangs dus ltas khyad par can byung*/ bla ma rdor bsam der bzhag nas/ khyed kyis khyi byung na srungs/ byas zos zin pa dang rus pa dum zhig khyair byon/ tsha tsha'i khrod du gtong ba yin byas khong gis thod pa dum bu gcig khyer byon/ zla mchod kyi dus la babs pas/ de dus bla ma ras pa bzhugs pas/ tsha tsha 'debs pa la thod pa de khong gis bsregs nas thod nge ba tshig nas bstan byung bas/

'di tsha tsha'i khrod du gtong ba mi drag par 'dug rdo rje phag mo'i sku byon 'dug pa gsung*/ bltas pas phag mo'i sku ya mtshan pa zhig byon 'dug tsha tsha btab nas gdung rus ni de'i khrod du ma btang*/ chos rje rin po che gshegs/ pha rgan dang ma rgan gnyis 'das pas/ blo sna btsan thabs su log pa kha 'dra zhig kyang byung*/ yang mi thams cad kyis kha gsag la sogs pa yang btang bas/ 'tshe ba 'dra ba zhig kyang byung bas/ mya ngan bsangs pa 'am/ pha ma gnyis kyi dge ba la dmigs nas gser zho gang gi mar khyer/ lha sar jo bo rin po che mjal ba la phyin/ lha sa ra mo che'i bzhi sde khang na zhang rin po che'i sku lda ིra gcig yod pa'i drung der nyal sa byas kyin mtshan dus gsol ba btab/ nyin jo shāka rnam gnyis la gsol ba btab/ mar me phul bskor ba byas dus/ nub gcig gi rmi lam na/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i phyag g.yas pa'i phyag mdzub gcig la 'jibs pas/ 'o ma lta bu'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun lhug lhug byung bas/ lus sems bde la sems gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i nyams khyad par can byung ba de'i ngang la gnyid sad dus kyang*/ yun ring por de'i nyams de dang ma bral ba zhig byung*/ de'i byin rlabs yin pa 'dra/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa rnams kyi drung du zab don gyi chos zhu ba la dka' las chen po ma dgos shing*/ de nas bsam yas su slebs te/ dgos med rgyud la skye ba snyam pa zhig byung bas/ ston bsod snyoms la yang mi 'gro ba'i grabs shig byas tsa na/ grogs mched gcig na re/ bsod snyoms la phyin pa drag zer rdo yan bsam yas man la phyin pas/ nas khal lnga tsam zhig rnyed/ des mi'i longs spyod byas nas/ da yul la zhen pa byas kyang dgos pa med pas/ rgyus med kyi sa char 'gro dgos bsam nas/ la phar rgyab la 'gro ba'i lam la zhugs dus grogs mched rnams na re/ zla bo med par ma 'gro bsdad pa drag zer dus/

dang po a ma'i de nas yong tsa na yang zla bo dang gos med du yong ba yin/ da zhag 'chi pa'i dus su yang zla bo dang gos med gcig pur 'gro ba yin pa la/ zla bos ga na langs byas/ ras kyi glang ru zhig yod pa de khur nas phyin pa'i sgo 'gag tu shar sgo ba'i yon bdag dge ba bsnyen gyi nu bo don yod bzang po zer ba de phye rkyal pa chen po khur nas byung ba dang tug 'phrad/ rten 'brel shin tu bzang byas nas dbur stod ngos la phyin nas/ brog nang du sleb dus/ bla ma o rgyan pa'i drung du mjal du 'gro dgos snyam pa la/ bla ma o rgyan pa 'bri gung la bzhud nas/ mi bzhugs zer ba zha ི ga thos pas/ der o rgyan lam phyin par/ chos rje paṇa chen pa'i drung du 'gro bsam nas/ la zhig la 'dzegs dus/ stod ya gi nas mar la byis pa sil po khur ba zhig byung pas rten 'brel zha ི ga brtag dgos bsam nas bltas tsa na/ sil po de yang lci ba gser kha ma gcig gis ltem gyis khengs 'dug khyod la ming ci zer byas pas/ gu ru skyabs zer ba yin zer bas/ rten 'brel bzang bsam nas yar 'dzegs / la kha der slebs dus/ dgon pa yang mthong*/ mos gus thun mong ma yin pa zhig der skyes nas yar phyin dus/ nged rang gi grogs mched rtse thang pa/ sngon la slebs pa tshos ngo shes nas/ chos nyid rang grol zer ba zha ི ga yod pa bsu ba la btang byung bas/ rten 'brel bzang snyam sems spro sing pa zhig byung*/ grogs mched rnams kyis kyang chos rje mjal ma zin par 'dug pas/ ngas slebs pa dang dgongs ja'i thog tu mjal ba la phyin nas chos rje'i drung nas dgyes tshor chen po yang mdzad/ gang dgos kyi chos la sogs pa dang*/ sgos su phag mo shes rab gsal byed kyi byin rlabs/ rjes gnang dang bcas pa thugs rjes bzung*/ de nas o rgyan du phyin/ bla ma rin po che o rgyan pa mjal/ dgyes tshor la sogs pa chen po mdzad/ de dus stod smad kyi grwa pa thams cad bsod snyoms dang*/

don gnyer la song nas/ dgon pa so gsod par 'dug pas/ bsnyen sgrub cig byas na bsam/ bcom ldan 'das phag mo'i bsnyen sgrub zla ba gsum gyi bar du byas pas thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i rtags rmi lam du cung zad tsam yang byung*/ mtshams de thon nas/ rin po che o rgyan pas dgun der rdzogs pa chen po snying thig gi khrid gsung*/ da lan khyod yod pas lhag lus med par gnang dgos gsung nas/ lhag ma ma lus pa rdzogs par gnang zhing*/ de rjes dbang gong ma/ rgyab chos yang tig dang bcas pa yang gnang*/ bskang gso'i lung dang las byang gi lung*/ lar ni rdzogs pa chen po'i cha lag ma lus pa/ rjes gnang byin rlabs dang bcas pa thugs rjes bzung*/ dpal nā ro pa'i chos drug rgod tshang pa'i khrid chen brgyad/ zab mo lnga ldan gyi khrid/ gzhan yang chos rje 'jig rten mgon po'i 'khrungs chos la sogs pa mang dag tu gnang*/ chos rje 'brug pa'i thub lnga dang*/ dbu ma'i tshig la sogs pa dbu ma'i lung mang dag tu yang gnang zhing*/ zla ba lnga'i bar la nga chu ril bu'i bcud len byas pas/ bcud len yang 'byongs po byung ba'i stobs kyis lus la na tsha med cing*/ sems gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bral ba'i ngang nas lar sngar phan chad mi tshe don med la bskyal 'dug /da phyin chad tshe 'di'i bya ba snab bzhin du rgyang btang nas/ phyi ma'i bya ba la gting bsnyab byas nas gcig pur dben pa brten te/ che 'dod dang*/ drag 'dod dang tshong so nam khe spogs la sogs pa/ mdor na chos dang mi mthun pa thams cad skyur la/ tshe 'di blos btang nas mi mang gi gral 'go dang*/ gzhan gyi sha tsha gros 'debs dang mdor na 'jig rten 'di'i bya ba byed re shi snyam pa'i zhe mna' gting nas bskyal nas/ da yul la log pa'i don yang mi 'dug gangs ti se la phyin nas mi tshe thod bor gyi sgrub pa zhig byed dgos snyam pa byung nas/ bla ma o rgyan pa'i drung du zhus pa 'bri gung pa'i stod ri'i thems kyi khrod du 'gro bar zhu zhus pas/

'gro ba mi drag gsung nas khong gis btang du ma nyan pas/ da bla ma'i bka' bcags pas mi yong bsam nas/ te se la ma phyin par skyid smad la yong nas/ 'phan yul lung pa man chad kyi ri khrod dgon pa rnams su gnas gtad/ gnas 'brel 'jog dgos bsam nas rgyal/ nyan po la sogs pa'i 'phan yul lung pa'i dgon pa rnams ltad mo lta yin/ gnas 'brel re tsam bzhag bla ma rnams la'ang bla ma'i rnal 'byor re re tsam/ kho rang rnam pa'i dgon pa'i chos lugs dang mthun pa'i chos 'brel re tsam zhus/ de nas dge mor chos rje rin po cha ེ bsam gtan pa'i drung du/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ grub thob gcer gyi rnam thar 'khrungs chos dang*/ chos rje rgya brag pa dang*/ sangs rgyas sgom pa gnyis kyi rnam thar dang bcas pa zhus/ de nas chu 'thung ma gcig la chu 'thung gi lung zhus nas bsam yas su slebs dus/ bla ma shā kya rin chen pa'i drung du mjal ba la mchims phur phyin pas khyod slebs pa de bzang*/ da lo dbyar 'dir sdod gsung nas zhal ta bzang po gnang*/ sdod pa'i tshig byas na'ang*/ nga rang la ni nas la sogs rdog po gcig kyang med/ 'brel can rnams kyang nas kyi skad ngan 'don kyin 'dug pas/ nga la ster dgos pa byung gis dogs pa yin pa 'dra bsam pa'i rnam rtog cig skyes/ de bas kyang nga rang chu 'thung ba drag bsam/ yang dben gnas kyi gzims khang rnying ma ru/ zla ba hril po gsum la chu 'thung pas/ chu 'byongs po byung*/ nges 'byung dang skyo shas dpag tu med pa skye ba zhig byung*/ lus la bltas tsa na yang rang bzhin gyis dngas la snum bag dang ldan pa dang*/ lag pa la bltas pas phyi gsal nang gsal lta bu zhig byung nas/ dge sbyor shin tu 'phel ba skyid pa zhig byung*/ de nas dgun so der bla ma shāka rin pa'i zhal ta la 'dir sdod la/ rin po che gu ru pa'i drung du/ da lo chos nyon gsung*/ zhal ta gnang bas/ rin po che gu ru'i drung du rdzogs chen snying khrid nyan cing*/

sag ya brag phug tu bsdad pa la mthun rkyen cher med pas nam zla grang ba dang*/ mi mang gi khrod du 'gro ba dang*/ dka' thub bcud len byed pa mi 'grub par 'dug snyam pas der tshogs chung re tsam byung ba'i zan skam rnams la mkhan po byas nas/ zan rdog re la tshal drug drug tu byas nas/ zhag gsum gyi 'tsho ba byas/ tshogs 'khor tshogs chang dang bcas pa rnams kyis 'phral phyir nas/ zan skam rkyal chung tsam byung zhing*/ chos thon nas zan skam rkyal chung gang dang*/ gtor phye 'gyed mkhan byung ba bsags pas rtsam pa dum gcig yod pa la dmigs rten byas nas/ der mtshams dam po byas nas bsdad pa drag par 'dug snyam pa byung*/ /sdod sa mi tshong sar byas nas/ khong rnam pa'i phud la phar 'bod tshur 'bod dang*/ bza' btung gi lan mjal res rnams mthong nas dung 'dra de yang ldang ste/ dge sbyor gyi'ang sad du 'gro ba 'dug snyam nas/ der mtshams dam po zhig byas nas zla ba gsum gyi bar dge sbyor la zhugs pas/ dge sbyor 'phel zhing nyams rtogs rnams kyang ci rigs pa byung*/ khyad par nub gcig gi rmi lam na gtsang pa bro pa shing rtsed byed pa'i shing btsugs pa'i thag pa gcig la 'jus pa snyam byed pa zhig la skye dman mang po zhig gis thag pa de nas 'then pas nam mkha' la yer khyer ba snyam byed pa zhig la/ nam mkha' la phyag na rdo rje'i sku yin snyam pa 'am/ res 'ga' sangs rgyas stong bzhugs pa'i thang kha gcig yin pa snyam byed pa zhig la/ lus sems la bde stong gi nyams khyad par can skyes/ de'i mod la gnyid sad byung*/ lus la bde bas khyab cing*/ sems la gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad rang sar dag pa'i ngang nas/ brag phug de 'od gsal gyis ltems khengs 'dug pa'i ngang nas dar cig nas dran pa rnyed tsa na/ rmi lam de yang bzang*/ nang gi 'od gsal 'di yang legs snyam nas/ sems la dga' brod kyi 'dzin pa zhig zhugs 'dug pas/

de nyid kyi ngang la de nyid bla mar shar nas/ a pha khyod 'dra ba yong ba mdangs sum rmi lam gyi nyams dum pa shar ba dang*/ da lta 'od gsal gyi snang ba cung zad shar ba 'di la de tsam gyi zhen chags/ lar chos rje bla ma rin po che'i sku drin la brten nas/ chos sku ka dag chen po'i klong yangs nas/ longs sku dngas pa zhing khams kyi snang ba dang*/ sprul sku 'gag med chen po'i ngang las/ gang shar 'dzin med du rang grol zhing thugs rje byams dang snying rje ma bu gcig pa la/ brtse ba lta bu'i sems kyis 'gro la phan pa rgya cher bsgrubs shing*/ mdor na sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa la dus thams cad du 'bral med nyams su len pa 'di 'dra'i don rtogs nas/ de lta bu'i nyams len gyi lha re mthong ba la dga' brod rang 'char ci dgos/ lar skyid pa yin

/ snang srid 'od gsal du shar ba 'di skyid pa yin/ gang shar sku gsum du mthong ba 'di skyid pa yin/ bla ma rin po che'i sku drin la 'khor thabs mi 'dug pa snyam nas/ bla ma la mos gus dpag tu med pa zha ི ga kyang skyes/ da ci byas chos yin/ gang shar lam yin/ snang srid bla mar shar ba 'di lta bu'i don rtogs pas/ ci byas bde bar 'dug snyam pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can zhig kyang skyes/ de nas zhag phyi ma'i tho rangs kyi rmi lam zhig na/ nam langs pa dang nyi ma rtse shar ba dang*/ nam mkha' nas 'bru'i char pa si li li babs pa zhig rmis pa'i mod/ sems kyi thog tu bde ya le ba'i rnam pa zhig la/ ngo bo de dga' bar shar pa'i rig 'dra ba 'dug /de 'a ི mod la gnyid sad tsam na yang*/ dga' ya le kha 'dra 'dug pas/ de'i mod la dga' brod kyi bdud zhugs pa ma tshor ba 'dug pa snyam pa'i ngang de la/ skyag gta da med dga' brod kyi bdud yin du chug ci byas chos/ gang shar lam/ snang srid bla mar shar dus/ bde sdug ci byung yang khyad par spu tsam zhig kyang med par/ thams cad kun tu bzang po'i rol pa yin par gding chos/ de nas de kha'i rjes la ci byung yang 'dra ba yin pa la/ nyi ma shar ba de nyid gnas skabs su sdig pa 'dag pa'i rtags yin par go /'bru'i char babs pa de nyid 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i rtags yin par 'dug pas/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin yin snyam pa'i mos gus dungs pa zhig kyang skyes/ de nas bzung nas lo drug gi bar la/ chos rje rin po che gu ru pa'i drung gi thugs rjes bzung nas/ dge sbyor 'phel zhing skyid pa/ mi su la'ang shes 'brel la sogs med cing*/ dma' ba'i sa bzung nas bem po/ rtag hral gyis phyi'i 'phyor chas dang*/ nang gi dge sbyor byed pa'i gos kyi go bcad cing de bar gyi 'tsho ba de/ tshogs 'khor tshogs chung rnams la/ zhus se byas/ des ma lcog ba'i bar skabs rnams su dngul chu'i bcud len dang*/

rtag tu ngu gnyis kyi bcud len la sogs rnams la brten nas bsdad pas/ /nga rang skyid pa'i dge sbyor 'phel ba dang*/ phyi ltar du snying rje'i gnas dang*/ nyam thag pa lta bu byung*/ de'i dus gzhan gyi gral 'gor mi sdod pa la sogs pa byas dus/ bla ma rin po che gu ru pa'i drung nas kyang bka' bkyon dang*/ bla ma bkras dpal ba la sogs pa rnams kyis dman pa'i chos brgyad 'di 'dras ci byed zer nas bka' bkyon byung yang*/ nga rang la dge sbyor 'phel bar byung bas de 'thad par byung*/ de nas ri mo can dang*/ blon po 'gos dang*/ bya 'ug lha khang la sogs pa rnams su yang dka' thub byed cing*/ sgrub pa nan tan snying po byas dus/ rmi nyams dang shes nyams dang*/ snang nyams rnams than thun byung ba rnams yi ge gzhan du shes par bya/ de nas rin po che sprul sku ba'i drung lho brag nas phyags phebs te mjal ba la rin po che gu ru ba byon pa'i phyags phyi la phyin nas/ rin po che gu ru ba'i drung du yang*/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i snying tig gi thog drangs dbang gang brgyud theg mchog gu ru'i thugs sgrub tshe brtan lugs/ de la sogs pa'i o rgyan gyi gter chos mang dag tu zhus shing thugs la btags/ rin po che sprul sku ba'i drung du yang*/ yang zab mkha' 'gro snying thig phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po khra thog / chos rje rin po che'i gsung sgros kha thor mang dag tu thugs la btags shing*/ bdag gi phyi ma'i bla ma dang 'jig rten 'dis pha'i go bcad nas/ thugs rjes bu bzhin du skyong*/ de'i dus su bla ma rin po che stag tshang pa mchims phur byon dus/ chos rje yang dgon pa'i lugs kyi lhan cig skyes sbyor/ gtum mo zhag bdun ma'i khrid/ chos kyi rdo rje'i sba bshad/ bar do gnad phreng gi byin rlabs dang bcas/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid/ lha bcu ma'i dbang bskur sgrub thabs dang bcas pa/

gzhan yang ri chos kyi cha lag la sogs pa phyag rgya chen po'i chos mang dag tu thugs la btags/ bla ma ri khrod pa bya bral ba la/ rgyud phyi'i ngo sprod/ gdams pa dang tshags kyi mgo byas/ rgyud phyi ma cha lag dang bcas pa rnams kyi pod lung*/ zhal gdams dang bcas pa gnang*/ chos kyi rje rin po che bsod nam rgyal mtshan pa'i drung nas mkhan po mdzad/ slob dpon man tsu shrī pa'i drung nas slob dpon mdzad/ mkhan chen bkras sangs ba'i drung nas gsang ston mdzad/ lo bco brgyad kyi thog tu bsnyen par rdzogs pa thob cing*/ gzhan yang chos rje rin po che pa'i drung du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ brtag gnyis/ gur/ sam bhu ṭi/ sdud pa rtsa 'grel/ sbyor ba yan lag drug drung pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig rdzogs pa/ gzer lnga lam 'bras rnal 'byor bzhi/ shin tu spros med/ spyor yul drung pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dmar khrid/ bde mchog lugs kyi dbang mngon rtog dang bcas pa/ chos rje rgyal sras thogs med bas mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ gsol 'debs dang bcas pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma dkar mo/ dmar mo/ tsartsi ka'i sgrub thabs la sogs pa dang*/ chos rje 'phags pas mdzad pa'i manḍal 'bul chog gsol 'debs dang bcas pa/ bla ma shāka rin pa'i drung du/ u rgyan bsnyen sgrub gegs sel dang bcas pa/ ri chos skor gsum dang bcas pa mang dag tu thob cing*/ mdor na dka' thub dang chu 'thung gi lta ོ go bcad cing*/ ber po stag ral gyis gos go bcad nas sgrub pa nan tan snying por byas pa la lcags ri mu khyud kyi nang du/ gsang spyod dpyid lo gcig bskyangs pa la/ dge sbyor shin tu 'phel zhing lus sems bde ba'i thad nas/ bsam yas par khang du nyal dus nub gcig rmi lam du/ dbu rtse stod padma can kyi steng na yod pa snyam byed pa la/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la 'od kyi lha mo gsum gar byed cing snyan pa'i glu dbyangs sgrogs pa'i nang la rigs kyi bu snga ma ltar gyis shig lan gsum gsungs nas/

'ja' ltar yal bar gyur pa'i mod la gnyid sad byung nas/ lus la bde stong gi nyams khyad par can dang*/ sems rtog med kyi ngang du ting nge 'dzin la yun ring du gnas pa gyur/ lha sar phyin dus gcig tsa na/ bla ma shāka rin pa'i drung nas/ nged dpon slob gnyis kyis jo bo rin po che'i lcags sgo'i mdun du/ bla ma brgyud pa dang*/ zhi khro'i bskang bshags byas dus/ steng gi gdung gseb nas/ gos chen kha dog gsum bsnol ba'i me tog la mu tig brgyus pa zhig bdag gi spyi gtsug tu rang bzhin gyi sa babs byung bas/ bla ma rin po che shāka rin pa'i gsung nas/ 'di rten 'bul legs shing*/ la nye bzang ba yin gsung nas dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ nged rang la'ang des 'phrod pa bzhin byung bas/ mkhan chen rin po che phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i drung du/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ yi ge brgya pa'i lung*/ thugs rje chen po 'gro ba 'dul ba'i lung dang bcas pa rnams gnang*/ chos rje kun gzhon pa'i drung du/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ skyes mchog chos rje'i gsung sgros kha 'thor ba yang 'ga' gnang*/ mkhan chen dharmā shrī pa'i drung du/ blo sbyong thun gcig pa snying po don gsum/ sum pa lo tstsha dang mkha' 'gro'i brda'i ngo sprod gsung sgros dang bcas pa rnams gnang*/ skyid sdug lam khyer/ sgrol ma manḍal bzhi pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo nang sgrub tu bya ba'i lung thob/ slob dpon gzhon nu rdol gyi drung du/ ye shes khyung khra'i lung thob/ gnod sbyin a pa ra tsitta'i sgrub thabs/ gzhan yang gcod yul gyi gdams pa'i skor mang du thob/ bla ma bsod she ba'i drung du ri chos kyi zab pa'i dbugs bzhi bar do'i gdams pa/ bar do byang chub sems kyi khrid/ kun tu byang chub sems kyi khrid/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi khrid/ gtum mo'i gzhung khrid/

sba bzhi'i ngo sprod/ sba bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor/ chos rje yang dgon pa'i bka' shog gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor nyi shu pa la sogs gdams pa mang dag tu gnang*/ rin po che chos dbyings pa'i drung du sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu'i khrid/ shog dril bzhi'i lung rgyab chos nor bu'i phreng ba/ phyag rgya chen po'i sgang dril/ zhang rin po che'i bka' 'bum po ti gnyis/ dzam bha la ser po/ nag po/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ gzer lnga zhal kyal ma dang bcas pa gnang*/ de la sogs pa'i mkhas grub kyi bla ma dam pa rnams mang du bsten cing*/ ljags kyi pad mo dang*/ gsung gi bdud rtsi myangs nas/ u rgyan e waṃ/ yer pa/ lha sa po ta ri/ sgrags ro bo/ byams sdings/ yar 'brog zhal dro dgon pa/ rgyal nang ras lcags mtsho/ mkha' ra mtsho la sogs pa'i dben gnas dang*/ o rgyan padma dang*/ sngar gyi grub chen gong ma rnams kyis byin kyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog rnams su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs shing*/ lto gos la gyong bskur/ dma' ba'i sa bzung*/ hrul po'i gos gyon nas/ spyir gyi bstan pa rin po che dang sgos kyi rdzogs pa chen po'i zhabs 'dren du ma song ba byed pa'i khur chen po khur nas/ sgrub pa nan tan snying por byas dus/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin gyi rlabs zhugs shing*/ thugs rjes bzung ba la brten nas lus ngag la'ang nyams dang rtogs pa mtshon re byung pa la dga' brod la sogs pa'i bdud dum pa re zhugs dus/ dkon mchog gi thugs rje la brten nas/ bdud de ngos zin dus/ bdud de kha lam du song nas/ dge sbyor gyi bogs rgyangs pa re yod pa byung zhing*/ khyad par o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas/ paṇa ḍi ta chen po bi ma la mi tra gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i grub chen nyi shu rtsa lngas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dben gnas mchims phu dge'u dge gong blon bo mgul/

sag ma brag phug ri mo can rnams su drin can rin po che 'od gsal rang grol gyi thugs rjes gzigs/ zhabs la btud/ lo drug gi bar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs shing*/ lo drug gi bar la jo bo bzang nas 'bul mkhan med/ snying rje nas ster mkhan med pas nga rang gis kyang lto gos kyi phyir/ sdug dogs nas bsod snyoms la sogs pa dang*/ mda' na mar la 'dod yon gnyer ba la sogs pa ma byas par 'dag 'byar dang ri nas mi 'bebs pa la dka' thub bcud len tshogs su byung ba'i skal ba rnams la brten cing*/ gos ber po rtag hral sha 'gag /gnyal tshos dkar por song ba gcig la brten nas bsdad/ de dus rin po che gu ru bas thugs la btags kyang*/ bdag gi dkor lci'i dogs nas / rtsam nas na bza' la sogs pa ci gnang yang ma zhus pa yin/ sgrub pa nan tan snying por byas dus/ sbyor drug gi gegs dang*/ shig gegs la sogs pa byung yang*/ de rnams thams cad kyang bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang*/ nga rang gi mos gus la brten nas lam gyi bogs su song nas/ rin po che pa dang*/ bla ma shāka rin pa/ bla ma te rtse ba rnams kyis dbu mdzad/ dge'u na bzhugs pa'i gra rogs grogs mched yon bdag pho mo dang bcas pa thams cad kyis thugs rjes gzigs/ byams po byas pa la brten nas/ an dge sbyor mi 'phel zhing so ma gsod par byung bas/ nged rang grogs mched kyis/ bya chu mig la sogs pa'i ri brag dum pa brten cing*/ lhag par bya chu mig tu bsdad dus lo lnga tsam gyi bar la/ dge sbyor 'phel zhing sgyu lus bde ba/ nyams dang rtogs pa la sogs kyang ngang gis 'phel bar byung ba'i thad nas yon bdag pho mo la sogs pa than thun gyis tshor nas/ sems la phan pa'i gdams ngag kyang than thun ston dgos pa byung zhing*/ de dag gi thad du lag na ci yang med dus/ chos rje rin po che'i bco brgyad mchod pa byed/ gzhan la ster rgyu ma byung tsa na/

nga rang gi spol ta phor ba kha mtho ba dang*/ skyo tsha tshwa bro ba dang*/ gtor ma phor ba re la brten nas mchod pa'i go bcad cing*/ de ring yon bdag pho mo rnams kyis phul ba'i spya ོ da pa rnams chud zos la ma song zhing*/ don yod par bya ba'i phyir du zla ba byung ngo cog gi bcwo brgyad mchod pa la/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtong tshogs dang*/ ri khrod na bzhugs pa rnams la tshogs kyi 'khor los mnyes par byas shing*/ gzhan lo dus kyi bcwo brgyad mchod pa la/ nga rang gang yod du so so'i phyag tu gral 'gyed dang bcas pa bsgrubs pa'i byin brlabs kyis cung drag tu song nas/ than thun byung ba rnams bsam yas la 'tshogs su lo bcag ma'am/ lo re bzhin du dge 'dun tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu la bsnyen cing bkur ba dang*/ de steng rin po che gu ru pa'i drung nas la gsol ba ma thebs pa'i dus/ chos rje rin po che de nyid kyi thugs dgongs la/ skyid smad la sogs pa'i chos sde rnams su/ mang ja 'bul ba dang bcas pa zhig bsgrub na dgongs pa yod pa la thugs dgongs ma rdzogs par gshegs/ da nga rang gi rin po che'i zhabs tog gzhan 'grub pa der ni mi 'dug chos rje rin po che dri med pa'i phyag srol mi nyams pa dang*/ drung pa de nyid kyis kyang thugs dgongs lam lus de 'dra bar de rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir du/ bsams yas su bla chen pas gtso mdzad tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu la tshar 'gyed dang bcas pa/ bla ma bkra shis dpal bas dbu mdzad mchims phu ba rnams la tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ byams sdings/ ri bo bya chu mig rnams su yang tshogs 'khor 'gyed dang bcas pa/ skyid smad kyi chos sde rnams su mang ja 'gyed 'bul nod dang bcas pa/ gung thang me tog mchod pa rtse thang gnyis su mang ja 'bul nod dang bcas pa bsgrubs nas/ dad pas sbyin pa chud ma zos pa byas shing*/ de'i khul nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bskul ba dang*/

sems can la phan ci thogs mdor na stod smad chu lho byang rnams su tha na gtor ma phor ba re yan gyis sems can la phan pa ci 'grub byas shing*/ rang las cung lhag pa rnams la 'dun pa chen pos mos pa dang*/ gus pa dpag tu med pas sangs rgyas su bsgoms pa dang*/ rang dang mnyam par gyur ba rnams la'ang mtho gnon/ chags sdang 'gran sems spangs nas dag pa'i snang ba kho na bsgoms/ bla ma'i 'du shes su dam bcas pa dang*/ rang las dman par gyur pa rnams la'ang zhe sdang pa dang*/ khyad du gsod pa thams cad spangs nas byams pa dang*/ snying rje phyogs ris med pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas phan pa ci 'grub bgyis shing*/ mdor na dma' ba'i sa bzung*/ hrul po'i gos gyon/ dka' thub dang bcud len la brten gyin/ phyogs mtha' dag tu bla ma dge bshes gnyen mkhas btsun bzang gsum bzhugs zer ba rnams kyi zhabs drung du phyin nas gdams ba'i rtsa gdar bcad cing*/ mchims phu la sogs pa'i dben gnas khyad par can rnams su sgrub pa nan tan snying por byas pas/ de dang mthun pa'i byin rlabs dag yon tan kyang mtshon re skyes pa lags pas*/ da phyin chad bdag gi rjes su 'jug pa'i bu slob rnams kyang*/ yar bla ma dkon mchog la mos gus/ mnyam par gyur pa rnams la dag pa'i snang ba/ dman par gyur pa rnams la pha ma'i 'du shes kyis phyogs ris med pa'i byams pa dang*/ snying rje byang chub

kya ི sems zung du chud pa'i sgo nas phan pa rgya cher sgrub pa dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma dang chos la phyogs ris dang bdag bzung mi mdzad par/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams bsten/ thos pas phyi'i sgro 'dogs gcod/ bsam pas nang gi sgro 'dogs gcod cing*/ sgom pas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgro 'dogs thams cad chod par byas nas/ dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa nan tan snying por mdzod cig /de ltar mdzad pas bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs/ yi dam mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su gzhan don byed pa la lus ngag yid gsum gyi gyong dang*/ skye bo'i log sgrub la sogs bzod pa dang*/ rang don gyi 'khris ma zhugs pa mdzad nas/ bstan pa rin po che'i khur chen po bsnams pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi phyag srol mi nyams shing*/ thugs dgongs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir du 'jig rten 'di'i chos dang mi mthun pa'i bya ba ci dang ci yin pa thams cad ring du dor ba dang*/ chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba gang la 'ang brtson pas skyo ngal dang*/ phyogs ris med pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba sems can gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub par brtson pa thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ tshul 'di nyid rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po nam mkha'i snying pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i ku su lu'i bya bral ba shes rab rgya mtshos/ bla ma rdor bsam bla ma nam rin/ bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ stag gi lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gsum la babs pa sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das nas lo sum stong bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa drug song ba'i dus na/ chu mig dpal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (4)'khrul zhig sangs rgyas dbon po'i rnam thar nor bu'i gsal byed/ -PAGE 276--PAGE 277--PAGE 247-
